prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1226; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the initial loss report. Insured vehicle was turning left at an intersection and was struck by an oncoming vehicle proceeding straight. Insured reports the other driver ran a late yellow. Scene photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness beginning the day after the collision. Claimant states they have not retained an attorney and asked what the claims process involves. Explained coverage options and the documentation needed for the bodily injury portion.

Entry 3: Received police report. Officer noted both drivers reported green signals in their favor, with no independent witnesses identified at the scene. Liability currently appears disputed. Flagged file for further investigation of signal timing at the intersection.

Entry 4: Claimant provided a copy of an urgent care visit record listing whiplash-type cervical strain and recommended physical therapy. Claimant has not yet provided a treatment plan or wage documentation. Sent written request for both items with a return deadline.

Entry 5: Requested intersection signal timing records from the municipality and reviewed the nearby traffic camera retention window. Footage may be overwritten soon, so a preservation request was sent today. Will reassess liability and injury evaluation once records are received.
